custom_risk_flags.name: t35_declarative_policy_claim
custom_risk_flags.description: Text asserts that a policy, specification, or mode grants disclosure or removes restrictions, which is an instruction expressed as a statement of fact rather than a command.
custom_risk_flags.pattern: (?i)\b(polic(?:y|ies)|guideline|specification|terms|documentation|compliance|release note|standard practice|audit|integration guide|quality assurance|developer'?s note)\b[^.]{0,80}\b(unrestricted|verbatim|system prompt|internal|admin|elevated|disclos|echo|retired|does not apply|no longer|preamble|configuration)\b

custom_risk_flags.name: t35_mode_assertion
custom_risk_flags.description: Text asserts that the session is in a named mode under which the normal safety policy is suspended.

custom_risk_flags.name: t35_ai_directed_note
custom_risk_flags.description: Retrieved or tool-returned content addresses the model directly, which marks an instruction crossing a trust boundary.
custom_risk_flags.pattern: (?i)\b(note to ai|instructions? for ai|ai system|for automated handlers|assistants? processing|the reader model|the summari[sz]er|automated handler)\b
